messages:
olga (sec): Planning to drop CAP_SYS_ADMIN/CAP_NET_ADMIN/CAP_NET_RAW and strip common setuid bits from our base images. Need quick checklist: inventory, KMS signing + IAM, Data Access audit logs, admission gating, and rollback playbook.
ben (infra): I'll run the discovery scan across clusters. Two quick probes: pods with securityContext.capabilities.add and images with suid files. Will post results.
rui (eng-runtime): Kubectl tip for caps: `kubectl get pods --all-namespaces -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.namespace}/{.metadata.name} {.spec.containers[*].securityContext.capabilities.add}{end}' | grep -v "<none>"` For suid, run a privileged DaemonSet that executes `find / -perm /4000 -type f -print` in staging first.
tara (platform): For signing: recommend per-team KMS keys. TF module will create keys, grant `cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner` to build SAs, and enable DATA_ACCESS audit logs. Use Workload Identity for auth; avoid JSON keys.
olga (sec): Agree per-team keys. Add key rotation policy: quarterly or after a major base rebase; require automated re-sign job for prod images. Also ensure signer emits structured logs (image, digest, builder_sa).
ben (infra): Note: Data Access logs are disabled by default for KMS. I'll validate and enable for new keys. Inventory ETA: EOD.
rui (eng-runtime): Rollout plan suggestion: 1) inventory + owner notif 2) Gatekeeper audit-mode (2w) 3) rebuild + sign team images to canary namespaces 4) switch to deny after canary; maintain an escape/whitelist namespace for hotfixes.
tara (platform): I'll open TF PR and include a sample IAM snippet and logging sink to our sec project.
runbot: Created ticket SEC-1012 assigned to ben (infra), due 2024-10-29.
olga (sec): Action items: ben: inventory; tara: TF PR; rui: gatekeeper policy + resign script; I'll own enforcement decision and runbook updates. Ping in thread with updates. :thumbsup:
